title: Depth of a circuit vertex
statement: Let $n$ be the number of input vertices, let $g_1,\ldots,g_m$ be Boolean gates, and let $v$ be a vertex index. Evaluate the gates in order starting with depth $0$ at each input vertex, and take the depth at index $v$; if that index is outside the resulting list of depths, return $0$.
caveat: The supplied snippet uses a gate-depth operation but does not include its definition, so the precise gate-depth recurrence cannot be confirmed.
